Base rbind() / cbind() for GPU tables

Source: R/bind.R
tbl_gpu-rbind.Rd

rbind(gt, ...) is bind_rows() (keeping the first table's groups) and cbind(gt, ...) is bind_cols(), so the result is a tbl_gpu built on the GPU (base R would otherwise bind the internal fields of the list). Base R picks the method from the arguments, so this applies when a tbl_gpu comes first (or no argument is a plain data.frame).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
rbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

# S3 method for class 'tbl_gpu'
cbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

Arguments

...

tbl_gpus, data frames and vectors, as for bind_rows() / bind_cols().

deparse.level

Ignored.

Value

A tbl_gpu; a data frame when an input has a list or data frame column (see bind_rows()).
